tools.Name: Crawl4AI
tools.Description: An open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler that transforms web content into clean Markdown suitable for RAG and AI agent pipelines.
tools.Use_Case: Extracting structured data and cleaning web content for AI model training or agentic workflows.

tools.Name: Claude Code
tools.Description: An agentic coding tool that resides in the terminal to execute tasks, handle git workflows, and explain codebase components via natural language.
tools.Use_Case: Automating routine coding tasks, debugging, and managing git operations directly from the terminal.

tools.Name: VoiceStudio
tools.Description: A fully-local, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs for voice cloning, dubbing, dictation, and audiobook creation.
tools.Use_Case: Generating high-quality, local synthetic audio, voice cloning, and audio transcription without cloud dependency.
